context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter-6 finishing-pass surfaces are green. Two intentional 503/409 by-design paths: (a) /api/checkout/subscription returns 503 until STRIPE_PRICE_CB_* env vars are populated, (b) /api/portal/billing-session returns 409 until a webhook caches stripe_customer_id on the subscriptions row. /api/share-demo will start returning sent=true once RESEND_API_KEY is set — no code change needed. Only known caveat: /api/portal/login uses magic-link style and does not return the token in the response body, so the backend test for the 401→409 progression is structured as a skip when no token is available; the UI test seeded a user directly via mongo to verify the 409 path end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Single test fixture skip (test_billing_no_customer_id_409) is by design — portal/login is a magic-link flow that emails the token rather than returning it in the response.
